Inclusivity Award

Who is allowed to have a voice in iGEM, synthetic biology and science more broadly? How have you developed new opportunities to eliminate barriers?

Who this project is for

Barriers we found

Language, cost, land tenure, literacy, connectivity, gender. Name them from evidence, not from assumption.

What we changed

Design changes, not intentions.

Language and access

English-first pages with 繁體中文 where a name, a quote or a term is Chinese, and a farmer-facing artefact that inverts that. Say what exists in which language.
